title: Describe people without skin tone
statement: When describing a person for a generated picture, name hair, glasses and clothes, never skin tone.
detail: Among the design decisions recorded for the Grade 9 guide, character descriptions name hair, glasses and clothes only, never skin tone, for a guide offered with female and male options and a range of looks. The file gives no reason for the rule, and nothing measures its effect.
against: The file gives no reason for the rule, and nothing measures its effect.
